newsitem.title: USA: Aon begins Alexander tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Aon begins Alexander tender offer.

text.p: Aon Corp said Monday its subsidiary has commenced a previously announced tender offer for shares of common stock of Alexander & Alexander Services Inc at $17.50 a share.
The tender offer is being made under a December 11, 1996 merger plan valued at about $1.23 billion. The tender offer is scheduled to expire on January 14, 1997.
Aon is a holding company that offers insurance brokerage, consulting and consumer insurance services. Alexander & Alexander, based in New York, provides insurance and human resources services.
Shares of AON closed up 2-1/4 to 63 while shares of Alexander & Alexander closed unchanged at 17-1/8.
